evidence.reason: The launch record is appended at line 714 after Popen at 712 but before the try block at 716 that arms termination, wait, and scope cleanup. If Recorder.append() raises, boot exits without stopping or reaping the child and without closing qemu.log, leaving the spawned systemd-run/QEMU process able to outlive the CLI. Moving the append inside the existing try is the smallest compatible fix.
